id: 05_Flammables and Explosives in the Laboratory - [Lab Safety Training Video]
title: 实验室里的易燃易爆物
source_doc: course/Fire Safety & Extinguisher Training/05_Flammables and Explosives in the Laboratory - [Lab Safety Training Video].md
author_source: project/Fire Safety & Extinguisher Training/05_Flammables and Explosives in the Laboratory - [Lab Safety Training Video]/src.py

points.K13: 查 SDS 的燃烧数据

shots.scene: 欣欣站在黄色易燃品柜旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a closed yellow flammables safety cabinet with a flammable warning sign and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲实验室里的易燃易爆物。
overlay: 实验室里的易燃易爆物

shots.scene: 火焰、通风柜、柜子、灭火器四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a flame, a fume hood, a safety cabinet and a fire extinguisher. No people.
shots.narration: 认得清、管得住、存得对、救得及。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一瓶溶剂走向开着的加热板
shots.prompt_en: The young male student carries a bottle of solvent with a flammable label toward a hot plate that is switched on.
shots.narration: 阿杰想把溶剂放到加热板上烘一烘。

shots.scene: 易燃瓶子放在加热板上的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a flammable bottle sitting on a glowing hot plate, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 这可是起火的老路子。

shots.scene: 小研快步上前，关掉加热板，摆手阻止
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hurries over, switches off the hot plate and raises her hand to stop him.
shots.narration: 小研赶紧关掉加热板，拦住了他。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 易燃易爆物，一点火星就够了。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起火焰象形图
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a GHS hazard pictogram with a flame.
shots.narration: 先学会认标志。

shots.scene: 火焰、爆炸弹、圆圈上方火焰三个 GHS 象形图
shots.prompt_en: Three GHS hazard pictograms in a row: a flame, an exploding bomb and a flame over a circle. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃、爆炸、氧化，各有图形。

shots.scene: 墙上的当心火灾警告标志
shots.prompt_en: A flammable warning sign on the wall of a lab storage area. No people.
shots.narration: 存放处还有当心火灾的警告标志。

shots.scene: 小研指着瓶签上的象形图给阿杰看
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at the GHS hazard pictogram on a bottle label for the young male student.
shots.narration: 看到这些，就要格外当心。

shots.scene: 一瓶贴着火焰象形图的溶剂
shots.prompt_en: A bottle of solvent with a flame GHS hazard pictogram on its blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃物，就是容易着火燃烧的物质。

shots.scene: 常见实验室溶剂瓶排成一排
shots.prompt_en: A row of solvent bottles with blank labels and flame pictograms on a shelf. No people.
shots.narration: 很多常用溶剂都是易燃物。

shots.scene: 两只相同的培养皿并排，一只下方是冰块图标，一只下方是温度计上升
shots.prompt_en: Two identical dishes side by side; under one is an ice cube icon, under the other a thermometer icon with a rising arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 同样的液体，一份冷，一份热。

shots.scene: 热的那皿上方飘出蒸气云，冷的那皿没有
shots.prompt_en: Vapor clouds rise above the warm dish, while the cold dish has none. No people.
shots.narration: 温度够了，才会冒出可燃蒸气。

shots.scene: 温度计上标出一条线
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon with a highlighted line marked on it and a small vapor cloud above. No people.
shots.narration: 这个最低温度，就叫闪点。

shots.scene: 蒸气云旁一个小火焰图标，液体本身没有火
shots.prompt_en: A small flame icon touching a vapor cloud above a liquid surface, while the liquid itself has no flame. No people.
shots.narration: 记住：烧的是蒸气，不是液体本身。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着飘散的蒸气云
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a faint vapor cloud drifting above an open bottle.
shots.narration: 蒸气看不见，却会四处飘散。

shots.scene: 火焰象形图和爆炸弹象形图并排
shots.prompt_en: A flame GHS hazard pictogram and an exploding bomb GHS hazard pictogram side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃物和爆炸品，一直都危险。

shots.scene: 爆炸弹图标四周有向外的箭头
shots.prompt_en: An exploding bomb pictogram with outward arrows and a heat wave icon around it. No people.
shots.narration: 爆炸品反应极快，瞬间放出气体和热。

shots.scene: 欣欣双手做出小心的手势
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds both paws out in a careful, calming gesture.
shots.narration: 这两类东西，都要格外小心。

shots.scene: 油桶图标旁边，蒸气云和小火花
shots.prompt_en: A fuel can icon with a vapor cloud and a small spark icon nearby. No people.
shots.narration: 有的燃料，很冷时也能冒出可燃蒸气。

shots.scene: 火花碰到蒸气，旁边是问号
shots.prompt_en: A spark icon next to a vapor cloud with a question mark between them. No people.
shots.narration: 但有火花，也不一定马上着火。

shots.scene: 蒸气和空气两种颜色的小圆点按比例混合
shots.prompt_en: Two colors of small dots, vapor and air, mixing in a box with a ratio bar. No people.
shots.narration: 还要看蒸气和空气的比例。

shots.scene: 一根浓度条，两端标出下限和上限，中间一段发红
shots.prompt_en: A horizontal concentration bar with a lower mark and an upper mark; the band between them glows red. No people.
shots.narration: 这个比例范围，叫燃烧极限。

shots.scene: 浓度条下限处有箭头
shots.prompt_en: An arrow points to the lower mark on the concentration bar, with a small flame appearing just above it. No people.
shots.narration: 低于下限，蒸气太少点不着。

shots.scene: 浓度条上限处有箭头
shots.prompt_en: An arrow points to the upper mark on the concentration bar, with a crossed-out flame beyond it. No people.
shots.narration: 高于上限，空气太少也点不着。

shots.scene: 一个瓶子图标对应一段很宽的红色区间
shots.prompt_en: A bottle icon linked to a very wide red band on the concentration bar. No people.
shots.narration: 有的溶剂，可燃范围特别宽。

shots.scene: 打开的瓶口飘出蒸气，浓度条很快升到下限
shots.prompt_en: Vapor drifts from an open bottle; next to it the concentration bar rises quickly to the lower mark. No people.
shots.narration: 而下限，往往很快就能达到。

shots.scene: 实验室房间图标上方有火焰和警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A simple lab room icon with a flame icon and a warning triangle above it. No people.
shots.narration: 所以实验室很容易起火爆炸。

shots.scene: 蒸气云中同时出现火焰和骷髅图标
shots.prompt_en: A vapor cloud containing both a flame icon and a skull icon. No people.
shots.narration: 蒸气多到能燃烧时，

shots.scene: 小人图标捂住口鼻，旁边警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram covering its nose and mouth next to a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 往往也已经超过了毒性限度。

shots.scene: 温度计升高，旁边一个小火焰自己冒出来
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon rising high, with a small flame appearing by itself with no match or spark nearby. No people.
shots.narration: 引燃温度：不用火，热到就自燃。

shots.scene: 台灯灯泡和蒸汽管图标，旁边一个瓶子
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a desk lamp bulb and a hot steam pipe next to a bottle with a flame pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 有的物质，灯泡、蒸汽管就能引燃。

shots.scene: 加热板表面发红，旁边一个溶剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: A glowing hot plate surface next to a solvent bottle with a flame pictogram, with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 加热板的表面，也足以引燃溶剂。

shots.scene: 小研拔掉台面上设备的插头，移开
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student unplugs a hot plate and moves it away from a bench where a solvent bottle stands.
shots.narration: 用易燃物前，把热源火花源移走。

shots.scene: 搅拌器和泵的图标，带小火花
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a magnetic stirrer and a small pump, each with a tiny spark symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 搅拌器、泵，也可能打出火花。

shots.scene: 酒精灯和加热板加热烧瓶的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an open flame burner and a hot plate heating a flask, both crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 加热易燃物，不用明火和加热板。

shots.scene: 加热套和水浴图标，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a heating mantle and a water bath, each with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 改用加热套或水浴。

shots.scene: 小人走过地毯，身上冒出小电火花
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram walking across a carpet with tiny static spark icons. No people.
shots.narration: 走过地毯，身上就会带静电。

shots.scene: 老周站在防静电地垫上，给容器接上接地线
shots.prompt_en: The older man stands on an anti-static floor mat and clips a grounding wire to a metal safety can.
shots.narration: 能用防静电措施，就一定要用。

shots.section_title: 查 SDS 的燃烧数据
shots.scene: 阿杰翻阅说明书，三个空白数据框亮起
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reads a blank safety data sheet; three blank data boxes light up beside it.
shots.narration: 拿不准，就查安全技术说明书。
overlay: 查 SDS 的燃烧数据

shots.scene: 几只气瓶立在墙边，旁边火焰象形图
shots.prompt_en: Several gas cylinders stand by a wall, with a flame GHS hazard pictogram beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 很多气体，既易燃又易爆。

shots.scene: 老李用绑带把气瓶固定在墙架上
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer straps a gas cylinder securely to a wall rack with a chain and a belt.
shots.narration: 气瓶要用链条或绑带固定牢。

shots.scene: 倒地的气瓶图标阀门断裂，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a fallen cylinder with a broken valve and a torn hose, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 倒了会撞坏阀门、扯断管线。

shots.scene: 放大镜对着接头和软管
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over a cylinder regulator fitting and a hose. No people.
shots.narration: 接头和软管，要定期检查。

shots.scene: 两只气瓶之间有隔开的箭头
shots.prompt_en: Two gas cylinder icons pushed apart by arrows with a divider between them. No people.
shots.narration: 会互相反应的气体，不能挨着放。

shots.scene: 几只颜色不同的气瓶，旁边问号
shots.prompt_en: Several gas cylinders in different colors with a question mark above them. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶里装什么，不能只看颜色。

shots.scene: 气瓶上的标签和挂牌发亮，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder with a clear blank label and a hanging blank tag highlighted with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 要看瓶上的标签，标签要保持完好。

shots.scene: 老李在接头处刷肥皂水
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer brushes soapy water onto a cylinder regulator fitting.
shots.narration: 取出气瓶后，接上再检一次漏。

shots.scene: 接头处冒出小气泡
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of small soap bubbles forming at a fitting, with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 冒泡，就说明漏气了。

shots.scene: 老李关闭阀门，挂上空白停用牌
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer closes the cylinder valve and hangs a blank tag on it.
shots.narration: 漏气就关阀停用，报告处理。

shots.scene: 爆炸弹象形图旁边是温度计、太阳、锤子图标
shots.prompt_en: An exploding bomb pictogram surrounded by a thermometer, a sun and a hammer icon. No people.
shots.narration: 不稳定的物质，怕热、怕光、怕撞。

shots.scene: 温度上升箭头指向一个摇晃的瓶子
shots.prompt_en: A rising temperature arrow pointing at a shaking bottle icon with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 温度一升高，就可能迅速分解。

shots.scene: 催化剂小颗粒图标，旁边警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A small icon of catalyst grains next to a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 有的杂质或催化剂，也会引发反应。

shots.scene: 两个瓶子靠拢，中间有红色闪电，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Two bottle icons moving together with a red lightning bolt between them, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 有些化学品，碰在一起就危险。

shots.scene: 遇水危险的危险货物标签和水滴图标
shots.prompt_en: A dangerous goods label with a flame over a blue background next to a water drop icon. No people.
shots.narration: 有的遇水，也会放出易燃气体。

shots.scene: 试剂柜分格，水龙头远离
shots.prompt_en: A storage cabinet with separate compartments, kept far away from a sink icon. No people.
shots.narration: 禁配的东西，存放时就要隔开。

shots.scene: 一个旧溶剂瓶，瓶盖周围有小结晶图标
shots.prompt_en: An old solvent bottle icon with small crystal symbols around the cap and a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 乙醚等溶剂，久放会生成过氧化物。

shots.scene: 瓶盖旋转图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand twisting the cap of the old bottle, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 它极不稳定，开盖的摩擦都可能爆炸。

shots.scene: 小研在新瓶上写开封日期
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes on a blank label of a new solvent bottle, with a calendar icon beside it.
shots.narration: 这类溶剂，开封要写日期。

shots.scene: 小研发现一瓶旧瓶，不碰它，拿起电话
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student spots an old bottle at the back of a shelf, leaves it untouched and picks up a phone.
shots.narration: 过期或有结晶，别动它，马上上报。

shots.scene: 老周和阿杰一起翻说明书
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the young male student read a blank safety data sheet together at a desk.
shots.narration: 操作和储存前，先查说明书和指南。

shots.scene: 通风柜气流箭头示意
shots.prompt_en: A simple side diagram of a fume hood with blue airflow arrows going in and up the duct. No people.
shots.narration: 通风特别重要。

shots.scene: 浓度条停在下限以下，绿色
shots.prompt_en: The concentration bar stays well below the lower mark, colored green, with a fan icon. No people.
shots.narration: 要让蒸气浓度远低于燃烧下限。

shots.scene: 小研在通风柜内倒溶剂，拉门放低
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in goggles and gloves pours solvent inside a fume hood with the sash lowered.
shots.narration: 在通风柜里操作，把蒸气排出去。

shots.scene: 火焰沿蒸气流倒回瓶口的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a flame running back along a vapor trail into a bottle mouth, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 局部排风，还能防止回火。

shots.scene: 通风柜旁加了一台辅助排风设备
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood with an extra auxiliary exhaust unit and airflow arrows beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 必要时，还要加辅助通风。

shots.scene: 阿杰把试剂瓶放进橡胶提桶
shots.prompt_en: The young male student places a glass solvent bottle into a rubber bottle carrier.
shots.narration: 搬运易燃易爆物，要用二次容器。

shots.scene: 提桶和塑料外套两个图标打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a rubber bottle carrier and a plastic bottle jacket, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 提桶、防护套都可以。

shots.scene: 大轮推车平稳推过门槛
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pushes a sturdy cart with large wheels and raised edges over a door threshold.
shots.narration: 地面不平，用大轮带护栏的推车。

shots.scene: 小轮仪器车翻倒、瓶子掉落的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a small-wheeled instrument cart tipping over with bottles falling off, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 仪器车、邮件车容易翻，不能用。

shots.scene: 试剂柜每格都有空白标签，瓶子各归各位
shots.prompt_en: A storage cabinet with blank labelled spaces, each bottle in its own place. No people.
shots.narration: 每种化学品，都有固定位置。

shots.scene: 小研用完把瓶子放回原位
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student returns a bottle to its labelled spot in the cabinet.
shots.narration: 用完马上放回去。

shots.scene: 太阳和暖气片图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A sun icon and a radiator icon near a shelf, both crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 远离热源，避开阳光直射。

shots.scene: 红色金属安全罐，带阻火嘴
shots.prompt_en: A red metal safety can with a spring-closing lid and a flame arrester spout. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃液体，用合格的安全罐装。

shots.scene: 安全罐嘴里的金属网，火焰被挡在外面
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway icon of the safety can spout with a metal mesh blocking a small flame outside. No people.
shots.narration: 罐口的阻火装置，能挡住回火。

shots.scene: 小研给安全罐贴标签
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sticks a blank label with a flame pictogram onto the safety can.
shots.narration: 容器都要贴好标签，别弄混。

shots.scene: 台面上堆满溶剂瓶的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a cluttered bench covered with solvent bottles, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要把化学品堆在台面上。

shots.scene: 台面上的瓶子被碰倒
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an elbow knocking a bottle over on a bench, with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 容易碰倒，起火时也没有保护。

shots.scene: 通风柜里挤满瓶子的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a fume hood crowded with bottles, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 也不要把通风柜当仓库。

shots.scene: 气流箭头被瓶子挡乱
shots.prompt_en: Airflow arrows inside a fume hood twisted and blocked by bottles. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶子挡住气流，起火还多了燃料。

shots.scene: 黄色易燃品柜，门上有当心火灾标志
shots.prompt_en: A yellow flammables safety cabinet with a flammable warning sign on its doors. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃易爆物，放进合格的安全柜。

shots.scene: 柜顶排气管上有阻火器图标
shots.prompt_en: The cabinet's vent pipe with a small flame arrester icon on it. No people.
shots.narration: 柜子若接排风，管上要有阻火器。

shots.scene: 老周关上柜门，上锁
shots.prompt_en: The older man closes the cabinet doors and locks them.
shots.narration: 柜门平时关好、锁好。

shots.scene: 普通冰箱里放着溶剂瓶的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an ordinary refrigerator with a solvent bottle inside, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 普通冰箱里，绝不能放易燃物。

shots.scene: 冰箱内部的开关火花图标
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway icon of a refrigerator showing a tiny spark at its internal light switch. No people.
shots.narration: 冰箱里的开关，会打出火花。

shots.scene: 防爆冰箱图标打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an explosion-proof lab refrigerator with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 需要冷藏，就用防爆冰箱。

shots.scene: 王老师和阿杰站在试剂货架前
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator talks with the young male student in front of a reagent shelf.
shots.narration: 实验室能存多少，是有规定的。

shots.scene: 货架旁一条限量线
shots.prompt_en: A reagent shelf with a red limit line drawn across it. No people.
shots.narration: 存量按学校规定，问清楚再存。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在几个不同颜色的柜子前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of several separate storage cabinets in a row.
shots.narration: 存放，还要分类。

shots.scene: 易燃柜、氧化剂柜、腐蚀品柜三个柜子图标，中间隔开
shots.prompt_en: Three cabinet icons kept apart: one with a flame pictogram, one with a flame over a circle, one with a corrosion pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃、氧化、腐蚀，分柜存放。

shots.scene: 氧化剂瓶和易燃瓶放在一起的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an oxidizer bottle next to a flammable bottle on the same shelf, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 氧化剂和易燃物，绝不能放一起。

shots.scene: 防爆柜下方有防漏托盘
shots.prompt_en: A safety cabinet with a spill tray at the bottom and a closed door. No people.
shots.narration: 储存按GB15603的原则来。

shots.scene: 王老师在空白展板前讲解
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stands in front of a blank display board with a padlock icon.
shots.narration: 有些化学品，属于易制爆品。

shots.scene: 专用柜、挂锁和登记本图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a locked cabinet with a padlock and a blank logbook. No people.
shots.narration: 专柜存放，专人管理。

shots.scene: 小研在空白台账上登记领用
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes in a blank logbook at a locked cabinet while the safety administrator watches.
shots.narration: 领用多少、用了多少，如实登记。

shots.scene: 不能转借的图标和电话图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of handing a bottle to another person crossed out with a red X, next to a telephone icon. No people.
shots.narration: 不外借，丢失被盗立即报告。

shots.scene: 空白法规文本
shots.prompt_en: A blank regulation booklet on a desk with a padlock icon on its cover. No people.
shots.narration: 具体按现行规定和学校制度执行。

shots.scene: 大瓶和小烧杯对比，小烧杯打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A large bottle and a small beaker side by side; the small beaker has a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 做实验，只用够用的最小量。

shots.scene: 通风柜里的装置前立着透明防爆屏
shots.prompt_en: A transparent blast shield standing in front of glassware inside a fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 有爆炸可能，装置放在防爆屏后。

shots.scene: 小研戴上面屏和手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on a face shield over her goggles and pulls on gloves.
shots.narration: 戴面屏，戴合适的手套。

shots.scene: 阻燃实验服图标，旁边火焰被挡住
shots.prompt_en: A flame-resistant lab coat icon with a small flame bouncing off it. No people.
shots.narration: 穿阻燃材料的实验服。

shots.scene: 阿杰检查柜里的瓶子
shots.prompt_en: The young male student checks bottles in a storage cabinet with a flashlight.
shots.narration: 经常检查储存的容器。

shots.scene: 生锈瓶盖和变色瓶子图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a rusty cap and a discolored, bulging bottle with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 看有没有腐蚀、渗漏、变质。

shots.scene: 阿杰把架边的瓶子往里推
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pushes bottles back from the edge of a shelf.
shots.narration: 靠在架边的瓶子，往里推。

shots.scene: 废液桶和说明书并排
shots.prompt_en: A closed waste container next to a blank safety data sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 这类废物，处置起来更复杂。

shots.scene: 小研戴防护对照说明书准备废液桶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in goggles and gloves checks a blank data sheet beside a waste container.
shots.narration: 先查说明书，做好防护。

shots.scene: 水槽下水道图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A sink drain icon with a solvent bottle pouring into it, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃废液，不能倒进下水道。

shots.scene: 下水管道里蒸气聚集、冒出火花的图标
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway icon of a drain pipe with vapor collecting inside and a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 管道里积了蒸气，也会起火爆炸。

shots.scene: 污水处理厂图标，旁边有骷髅
shots.prompt_en: A water treatment plant icon with a small skull icon passing through it. No people.
shots.narration: 污水厂也处理不了这些毒物。

shots.scene: 回收箭头图标，旁边爆炸弹象形图被红叉
shots.prompt_en: A recycling arrow icon next to an exploding bomb pictogram, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 爆炸性残留物，不冲、不回收。

shots.scene: 阿杰向老周请教
shots.prompt_en: The young male student asks the older man a question next to a closed waste container.
shots.narration: 怎么处置，先问实验室负责人。

shots.scene: 小研给废液桶贴标签，盖紧
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student labels a closed waste container with a blank label and tightens the cap.
shots.narration: 废物装好、盖紧、贴好标签。

shots.scene: 废物暂存区的几个桶整齐排列
shots.prompt_en: Several closed waste containers lined up neatly in a marked waste holding area on a spill tray. No people.
shots.narration: 放到指定暂存区，等统一收运。

shots.scene: 王老师递给阿杰一份空白处置规定
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands the young male student a blank waste procedure booklet.
shots.narration: 读懂学校的废物处置规定。

shots.scene: 阿杰手放胸前点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts a hand on his chest and nods seriously.
shots.narration: 自己用的东西，自己负责到底。

shots.scene: 老周和小研蹲在易燃品柜前讨论
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the female graduate student crouch in front of a yellow flammables cabinet, discussing.
shots.narration: 事先读应急预案，想好泄漏怎么办。

shots.scene: 地上一滩液体不断扩大的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a liquid puddle on the floor spreading wider, with arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃液体洒了，扩散很快。

shots.scene: 小研关掉加热设备电源
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student switches off the power to heating equipment on a bench.
shots.narration: 立刻关掉所有点火源。

shots.scene: 插头、加热板、明火图标都被关掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a plug, a hot plate and an open flame, each switched off with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 面积越大，越容易起火。

shots.scene: 墙上的溢洒处理箱
shots.prompt_en: A spill kit box mounted on a lab wall near the door. No people.
shots.narration: 溢洒处理器材，放在手边。

shots.scene: 王老师教阿杰佩戴防毒面具
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches the young male student how to put on a half-face respirator.
shots.narration: 用呼吸防护，先要接受培训。

shots.scene: 吸附颗粒盖住液体，上方仍有蒸气飘起
shots.prompt_en: Absorbent granules cover a spill, but vapor still rises above them. No people.
shots.narration: 普通吸附剂，挡不住蒸气挥发。

shots.scene: 专用吸附剂图标，蒸气被压住
shots.prompt_en: A special absorbent icon covering the spill, with the vapor held down. No people.
shots.narration: 选用什么吸附剂，问清楚再备。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在禁止烟火标志下
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands under a prohibition sign showing a crossed-out flame.
shots.narration: 火源，平时就要管住。

shots.scene: 香烟和打火机图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A cigarette icon and a lighter icon, both crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里禁止吸烟。

shots.scene: 明火图标旁边一张空白审批单
shots.prompt_en: An open flame icon next to a blank approval form with a stamp. No people.
shots.narration: 确需明火，按规定审批。

shots.scene: 多个插线板串联的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of several power strips plugged into each other, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 插线板不串接，电器用完断电。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着墙上的灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a fire extinguisher mounted on the wall under a fire extinguisher sign.
shots.narration: 灭火器和应急设备在哪，要清楚。

shots.scene: 王老师带学生练习灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator trains the young male student and the female graduate student to use a fire extinguisher outdoors.
shots.narration: 受过培训，才能上手使用。

shots.scene: 二氧化碳和干粉灭火器图标打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a carbon dioxide extinguisher and a dry powder extinguisher, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃液体小火，用二氧化碳或干粉。

shots.scene: 水桶浇向燃烧的液体图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bucket of water thrown onto a burning liquid, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃液体着火，不能用水泼。

shots.scene: 小人身上着火，躺地打滚的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person with burning clothes stopping, dropping to the floor and rolling. No people.
shots.narration: 衣服着火，别跑，就地打滚。

shots.scene: 电话图标旁写着119
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a red alarm burst. No people.
shots.narration: 火势控制不住，马上拨119。

shots.scene: 墙上的疏散图和安全出口标志
shots.prompt_en: An emergency exit sign above a door, next to a blank evacuation map on the wall. No people.
shots.narration: 熟悉疏散图，记住出口在哪。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰沿楼梯快速撤离
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student walk quickly down a stairwell following exit signs.
shots.narration: 起火或爆炸，撤离往往是唯一选择。

shots.scene: 集合点标志下大家集合
shots.prompt_en: An emergency assembly point sign outdoors with the older man counting the students.
shots.narration: 到集合点，清点人数。

shots.scene: 报告链条图标：实验室—学院—保卫处
shots.prompt_en: Three linked icons in a chain: a lab room, a department building and a security office. No people.
shots.narration: 出了事，报告负责人、学院和保卫处。

shots.scene: 电话图标和红十字
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a red cross icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 有人受伤，拨打120。

shots.scene: 保卫处值班员和老周在门口交接
shots.prompt_en: The security officer arrives at the lab door and talks with the older man, who hands over a blank booklet.
shots.narration: 向救援人员说明是什么化学品。

shots.scene: 欣欣严肃地看着镜头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot looks at the camera with a serious, focused expression.
shots.narration: 易燃易爆物，从来不能大意。

shots.scene: 阿杰专心操作，手机放在远处
shots.prompt_en: The young male student works carefully at a fume hood, his phone left on a far shelf.
shots.narration: 清楚每一步，时刻保持专注。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现火焰和放大镜图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a flame pictogram and a magnifying glass.
shots.narration: 知道哪些东西易燃易爆。

shots.scene: 火花图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A spark icon and a hot plate icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 身边不留点火源。

shots.scene: 通风柜气流图标
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood icon with airflow arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 通风要足。

shots.scene: 安全柜和推车图标
shots.prompt_en: A safety cabinet icon and a bottle carrier icon. No people.
shots.narration: 会搬、会存。

shots.scene: 灭火器和出口图标
shots.prompt_en: A fire extinguisher icon and an emergency exit sign. No people.
shots.narration: 随时做好应急准备。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在整齐的实验台前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a tidy lab bench.
shots.narration: 闪点、极限、引燃温度，查说明书。

shots.scene: 加热套、水浴和接地线图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a heating mantle, a water bath and a grounding clip. No people.
shots.narration: 不用明火加热，防静电。

shots.scene: 固定的气瓶、提桶和安全柜图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a strapped gas cylinder, a bottle carrier and a locked safety cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶固定，二次容器，分类入柜。

shots.scene: 带锁的专柜和登记本图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a locked cabinet with a padlock and a blank logbook. No people.
shots.narration: 易制爆品，专柜专人台账。

shots.scene: 废液桶、灭火器、电话图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a closed waste container, a fire extinguisher and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 废液不下水，着火拨119。

shots.scene: 欣欣在锁好的易燃品柜旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a closed and locked yellow flammables cabinet.
shots.narration: 远离火源，安全实验，下次见！
